name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-01-15, at wavelengths from 1.32 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
